messages.relevance: Cleaning and household goods wholesaler serving contractors, retailers and commercial businesses.
messages.subject: <ADV> Try StockWise free for Hup Soon & Company
messages.body:
Hello,

I’m the CEO of NexOps and the founder of StockWise, an inventory and purchasing operations platform for inventory-based businesses.

I’m reaching out because Hup Soon & Company appears to manage physical inventory, purchasing, or supplier operations.

StockWise helps teams identify inventory exceptions, purchase-order priorities, and supplier follow-ups without relying on repeated manual spreadsheet checks.

We’re currently offering StockWise free while we continue improving the product, so you can try it with your own inventory workflow at no cost during this trial period.

You can start here:
https://stockwise-homepage.vercel.app

If you prefer, you can also send me a sample Excel or CSV inventory file and I can help set up a StockWise dashboard using your actual workflow at no cost.

CEO, NexOps
StockWise: https://stockwise-homepage.vercel.app
NexOps LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexops2026/
nexops2026test@gmail.com

If you do not want to hear from me, reply “unsubscribe” and I will not contact you again.
